# Known-failing OpenJD conformance tests.
#
# Generated by the first run of `make test-conformance`. Each line is a fixture
# path relative to the 2023-09 suite root.
#
# This is a burn-down list, not an ignore-list. CI fails in BOTH directions: a
# test that fails without being listed here is a regression, and a listed test
# that starts passing is a stale entry that must be removed. Fixing conformance
# defects therefore shows up as deletions from this file.
#
# base/env_templates/* : not listed here. sqi does not implement standalone
# environment-2023-09 templates at all, so every fixture under any
# env_templates/ directory is StateNotApplicable (see classify.go) and is
# never scored — it cannot regress or go stale, so it has no baseline entry.
